snippet.title: Stash RPG - No Loot Left Behind (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Available NOW on Steam Early Access: http://store.steampowered.com/app/466660/

Stash RPG: turn based combat, exceptional housing, a wonderful community, and tons of loot! Remember all nighters with friends around the gaming table, feasting on snacks, and guzzling caffeine? We've turned that into an MMO: Stash RPG. 

Website: http://stash.frogdice.com
